meta.name: Anchor DS — Components manifest
meta.principle: Only components verified in the Anchor Figma are included. Anything not present in Figma is NOT added, even if shadcn has it.

figmaStatus.confirmed: Visible in Figma 'Components MVP3' or in one of the 22 exported screens.
figmaStatus.likely: Pattern present in the Figma (e.g. Figma layer named for it) but not fully nailed — verify before locking.
figmaStatus.unverified: Added speculatively. REMOVE if not in Figma.

components.name: Button
components.when: Any user action. Primary (default) = the commit action of a screen. One default button per surface.
components.dont: Don't use ghost for dangerous actions. Don't stack two defaults in one dialog.

components.name: Alert
components.when: Inline, in-page message. Not a toast.
components.dont: Don't use for ephemeral feedback — use Toast when added.

components.name: Badge
components.when: Status of a record (acquired, pending, failed, draft).

components.name: Card
components.when: Grouping related info or actions within a page.

components.name: Input
components.when: Single-line text entry. Pair with Label.

components.name: Select
components.when: Choosing one from a list under ~10 items. Over 10, use Command/search.

components.name: Switch
components.verifyNote: Appears needed for Settings screen toggles — confirm in Settings Figma frames.

components.name: Slider
components.verifyNote: Expected for Gain/Speed in ECG viewer — confirm the gain/speed controls are sliders, not segmented.

components.name: Tabs
examples: Realtime / Review / Manual Preview / Full Disclosure

components.name: Table
examples: Settings exam list at bottom of Components MVP3

components.name: Tooltip
components.verifyNote: A 'Sample tooltip' layer appears in the Figma left panel — confirm style.

components.name: PatientHeader
components.when: Top strip of every ECG screen (Realtime, Review, Manual Preview).

components.name: SettingsList
components.when: Settings application shell. Replicates the left-rail + right-detail pattern seen in Figma.

components.verifyNote: Seen as 'Icon Button_mvp3/mvp5', 'STAT Icon Button', 'Printer Icon Button', 'USB Icon Button', 'transmit_Icon Button' (e.g. 37646:53396, 37646:46325).
